### Quick ways to check the live AQI

| Platform | How to find Dwarka’s AQI | Tips |
|----------|--------------------------|------|
| **CPCB (Central Pollution Control Board)** | Go to the [CPCB Delhi portal](https://cpcb.nic.in/air-quality-monitoring/) → “Realtime Data” → pick “Dwarka” from the station list. | Data refreshes every hour; the site also shows PM₂.₅, PM₁₀, NO₂, SO₂, etc. |
| **AQICN (World Air Quality Index)** | Search “Dwarka, Delhi” on [aqicn.org](https://aqicn.org/city/india/delhi/dwarka/). | Colour‑coded map (green → good, red → unhealthy). |
| **India’s “AirNow” app** (Android / iOS) | Add “Dwarka, Delhi” as a favourite location. | Push notifications for spikes. |
| **Google Search** | Type “Dwarka Delhi AQI” → the top card shows the current value (sourced from CPCB). | Works even on a basic phone browser. |
| **Smart‑watch / Weather widgets** | Many Indian weather apps (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather) now embed AQI. | Handy for quick glances. |

---

### What you usually see in Dwarka

- **Typical range (Nov 2025 – Oct 2026):** 120 – 250 AQI (moderate to unhealthy for sensitive groups).  
- **Peak winter months (Nov‑Jan):** values can climb above **300 AQI** during severe smog episodes.  
- **Monsoon season (Jun‑Sep):** rain usually pushes it down to **50 – 100 AQI** (good‑moderate).

> *Pro tip:* If the AQI crosses **150**, consider a N95 mask for outdoor trips and keep windows closed during early mornings.

---

### Handy one‑liner for the terminal‑savvy

```bash
curl -s "https://api.waqi.info/feed/delhi-dwarka/?token=YOUR_TOKEN" | jq '.data.aqi'
```

*(Replace `YOUR_TOKEN` with a free token from aqicn.org. The command returns the latest AQI number.)*
